description: Design useful, accessible interfaces with coherent visual language, interaction states and motion.

interface.longDescription:
Design useful, accessible interfaces with coherent visual language, interaction states and motion.

Covers: UX, Design system, Accessibility.

Expected outputs: User journeys and interface flows; Layouts and interaction states; Design tokens and component guidelines; Accessibility and motion guidance.

Original skills used through Engineering Core: impeccable:impeccable, vercel:web-design-guidelines, wshobson:wcag-audit-patterns.

Optional specialist and framework packs: discovery, react-ui, expo, angular, swiftui, xylex-ui-polish. These are selected for the project when relevant; they are not all enabled by default.

Declared integrations: mobbin, paper, figma. These are integration recipes, not connected services; configure the corresponding tools and accounts separately.

Why the app shows one skill: this plugin exposes one entry skill which loads the relevant original specialists from Engineering Core on demand. The Skills count in the app is not the size of the shared upstream library.

Requires Engineering Core (finem-core). Tasks spanning multiple disciplines may also require the corresponding area plugins.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for UI/UX & Design System and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review UI/UX & Design System in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
